text: これを　どこかの　けんきゅうじょに　もって　いって　しらべて　ほしいんだ！

structure.jp: これを　どこかの　けんきゅうじょに　もって　いって
structure.en: take this to a lab somewhere and

structure.jp: しらべて　ほしいんだ！
structure.en: I want you to have it examined!

patterns.name: 〜てほしい
patterns.explanation: ほしい after a て-form verb says you want someone else to do it. しらべて　ほしい = 'I want you to get it examined'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says you do it and go away with it. もって　いって = 'take it there and'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end gives the feeling of explaining or stressing something. ほしいんだ = 'I want it, you see'.
